item.title: Blood inflammation markers may predict COVID-19 outcomes in younger patients only
item.description: In emergency department COVID-19 patients, inflammatory blood indices predicted 30-day mortality in younger adults but not in older ones.

item.title: IL-1 pathway may prevent Candida fungus from becoming deadly in immunocompromised
item.description: Researchers at King's College London identified an immune pathway that stops a harmless fungus from turning into a fatal infection.

item.title: THC from cannabis may reduce PTSD-related nightmares
item.description: Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) can arise from traumatic events, and a cannabis-derived compound shows potential in alleviating associated nightmares.

item.title: Adults born very preterm show distinct functional profiles
item.description: Adults born very preterm or with very low birth weight exhibit varied functioning in adulthood, with higher childhood IQ linked to better outcomes.
